narr: Scattered showers and storms formed ahead of a cold front during the evening of May 8 across central Virginia. These showers and storms produced locally heavy rainfall and flash flooding across portions of central Virginia on the evening of May 8.
ev: The 911 call center reported motorists stuck in the flood waters at I-295 and Staples Mill Road.
lsr: Motorist reported being stuck in flood water at I-295 and Staples Mill Rd.
